_comment: The town council (src/models/council.py, docs/council.md). Offices from the top of the pyramid down; a notable's 'office' is the seat he holds when a game starts (none: a notable of the town without a seat, who may stand for one). 'likes' is a good of goods.json; 'integrity' (0 to 1) is how surely he turns down a purse; 'arms' are his house's: a field colour, a charge (pale, fess, bend, chevron, cross, saltire, chief, roundel, lozenge, bars, quarterly) and its metal (gold, silver).

offices.name: Mayor
offices.duty: Speaks for the town before its lord and has the last word in the hall.

offices.name: Treasurer
offices.duty: Keeps the town's chest and its books, and seals every licence sold.

offices.name: Market Master
offices.duty: Rules the market squares: who may set up a booth, and what the fee is.

offices.name: Master Builder
offices.duty: Sees to the town's walls, roads and wells, and has his name on every one.

offices.name: Captain of the Watch
offices.duty: Commands the watch. Few dare to move against the man who holds the keys.

offices.name: Market Warden
offices.duty: Checks weights and measures at the booths for the Market Master.

offices.name: Town Clerk
offices.duty: Writes the council's minutes and the licences the Treasurer seals.

offices.name: Gate Warden
offices.duty: Counts the carts at the gates and takes the toll for the town.
